saga: Y1 Steward Aldous the Gray: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Aldous the Gray: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Mirefast. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Aldous the Gray: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y3 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y3 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y3 Steward Aldous the Gray: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y3 Steward Aldous the Gray: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y3 The war-camp stirs — Mirefast may march soon.
Y4 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y4 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y4 The host marches on Mirefast — 19 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y4 The host falls upon Mirefast! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y4 The war-tents of Mirefast burn. The camp itself is stripped — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods. The folk are spared — and they will remember.
Y4 The host returns from Mirefast with the hoard. Justice, not slaughter.
